strategy: Unmodified TradingEngine.scan, refresh, square_off_intraday and their real decision functions; current saved settings, five-category shared paper book
selection: Predeclared 20-symbol liquid equity panel, disjoint from Goal08-10 30 stocks; no screening using this window's prices or outcomes. Current-survivor selection, not point-in-time membership of all 1205 names.
unseen_claim: Newly acquired combined-engine holdout on disjoint symbols after the July archived daily panel. Not a claim that these companies or all historical dates have never appeared in other repository research. No tuning or selection on this holdout.
exits: Refresh every 30 minutes at the real cron boundaries and between category scans; intraday square-off at 15:25. Ideal zero-duration scan model, no unscheduled owner/web actions or optional five-minute scan job.
fill: Contemporaneous five-minute boundary OPEN, adverse slippage each side. Completed signal bars only. No stop-price fills, future high/low routing or daily-close fallback; absent boundary quote means unavailable.
report: closed economic trades and partial legs
terminal: Keep actual open positions. Mark at completed session closes; show hypothetical liquidation costs separately, never insert forced exits into actual strategy history.
forward: Observe normal app paper activity prospectively; no induced scans or trades. Immutable code/settings identity, raw own-symbol entry bars, original fees and fills, partial-leg identities, acknowledged outbox with restart retry. Baseline legacy positions excluded from new-entry expectancy.
forward_acceptance: Remain pending until at least 30 distinct new regular sessions and 30 fully closed economic trades in every claimed segment, complete costs/identities and declared data/mark coverage. These are coverage floors, not statistical proof. Any code/settings changes form separate cohorts. No automatic promotion.
limitations: bounded panel changes cross-sectional breadth/correlation/IFR; cannot claim whole-universe results
missing PIT news, fundamentals, FII, sector, valuation and spread data follow existing fallback policy and remain explicit unknown coverage
provider corporate adjustments/revisions and announcement-time lineage not independently certified
daily marked drawdown can miss intraday troughs; scheduled marked curve also reported
one historical holdout cannot establish future profit
initial_conditions: Fresh isolated INR 5 crore book, no inherited positions or outcome history. Measured Kelly learns only from earlier replay closes. Does not reproduce the production opening ledger.
